name: animate objects
lore:
# On the Transmutation of the Inert: Animate Objects

To invoke the spell *Animate Objects* is to grasp the Weave as a web of silver, vibrating threads. The caster feels a frantic, kinetic hunger thrumming through their fingertips, as if stitching their own pulse into the surrounding matter. You are not merely commanding; you are puppeteering the soul of the inanimate.

Upon the spell’s completion, the mundane stirs with unsettling vitality. Pewter pitchers sprout spindly legs of translucent force; tapestries ripple like predatory eels. These objects move with a jerky, stop-motion grace, accompanied by a low, resonant hum and the dry grinding of wood or stone suddenly granted joints.

Scholars trace this art to the "Calamity of the Cluttered Study." Legend tells of Archmage Vaelin, who, cornered by assassins in his library, channeled his panic into his furniture. The attackers were not felled by steel, but by a barrage of flying encyclopedias and a particularly vengeful mahogany wardrobe. It serves as a stark reminder to all adventurers: never underestimate the hidden, violent heart of a common chair.
